In practice, the magnetic core ex- hibits several non-ideal behaviors, including the phenomenon of magnetic saturation. Although some degree of saturation is acceptable in many power system applications, an abnormal and potentially severe saturation can occur if the transformer enters half-cycle saturation. This happens when a offset in the magnetic flux (e.g., due to GICs) resultsin the core becoming saturated during parts of the ac cycle when the ac component and dc component add constructively. Four-Leg Inverter One of the key contributions of the proposed SST design is the utilization of a four-legged converter for the ac/dc conversion instead of the standard three-leg inverter design. By adding an additional phase-leg, not only can the inverter control the standard dq components of the phase currents, but it can also control the zero-sequence (CM) component [12].
